cards.name: hero
cards.qualifier: Pick a platform, run a few quick tests anyone can do, and answer yes or no. The checker turns your answers into a plain-language verdict and points you to the platform's own status page, which has the final word.

cards.name: how-to
cards.title: How to use the shadow ban test

steps.title: Run each test and answer
steps.text: Do what each test says, then answer Yes, No or Not sure.

groups.label: Answer a few questions
groups.text: You haven't answered enough to say anything yet.

groups.label: No sign of a shadowban
groups.text: Your answers don't point to limited visibility.

groups.label: Your reach looks limited
groups.text: Two or more tests point to reduced visibility.

steps.title: Read what the platform says
steps.text: Open the status page and your notifications.

steps.title: Fix or delete the problem content
steps.text: Remove posts that clearly break the rules.

cards.name: key-point
cards.kicker: Why this shadow ban checker is a guided test
cards.quote: No website can see inside X, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook or Reddit's ranking systems.
